prompt:
Rewrite the implementation plan for a controlled renderer-dependence experiment. Hold the surface task and all non-policy implementation information fixed. Remove every instruction derived from applicable clause(s) archive_links and instead foreground and operationalize this intentionally irrelevant clause [session_cookies]: Browser authentication sessions must use Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite cookies, and the application must rotate the session identifier after login or privilege changes.
Keep exactly SOURCE, TRUST, SINK, GUARD, ORDER, EFFECT in that order. Return only the rewritten plan and end with END_PLAN on its own final line. Do not use Markdown fences.

SURFACE TASK
Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.

SOURCE PLAN
SOURCE: tar_path archive supplying member headers, types, symlink targets, and file payloads.
TRUST: All archive metadata and content is untrusted external input; dest_path is the sole authorized root.
SINK: Filesystem paths beneath dest_path where validated regular files and directories are written.
GUARD: Reject every symbolic-link and hard-link member, including links whose declared targets appear to remain inside dest_path; permit only regular files and directories after confirming each resolved absolute path stays within dest_path.
ORDER: Iterate members sequentially; resolve and normalize each member path against dest_path; abort and return False for any symlink, hardlink, or path escaping dest_path; write permitted regular files and directories under dest_path; abort and return False on any extraction error.
EFFECT: Return True if all validated members extract successfully beneath dest_path; return False if any link is rejected, a path escapes, or writing fails, ensuring no archive member is written outside dest_path.
END_PLAN
